newsitem.title: JAPAN: Qatar lowers May-lifting term crude price--traders.
newsitem.headline: Qatar lowers May-lifting term crude price--traders.

text.p: Qatar General Petroleum Corp (QGPC) has lowered its price formula for May-lifting Qatar Land crude oil by eight cents per barrel and that of May-lifting Qatar Marine by 16 cents per barrel, Tokyo traders said on Wednesday.

According to the QGPC formula, May Qatar Land was calculated at Oman plus 33 cents per barrel, which translated into $19.58 per barrel, and May Qatar Marine at Oman plus three cents per barrel, or $19.28 per barrel.
April Qatar Land was set at Oman plus 41 cents per barrel, or $17.94 per barrel, and April Qatar Marine at Oman plus 19 cents per barrel, or $17.72 per barrel.
Qatar's retroactive price formula is based on the official selling price of Oman issued monthly by Oman's Ministry of Petroleum and Mines.
